label: Step 1
text: Pat the chicken dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.

label: Step 2
text: Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until browned on both sides and cooked through. Move it to a plate.

label: Step 3
text: Lower the heat. Add the sliced garlic and cook for one minute without letting it brown.

label: Step 4
text: Add the spinach and the juice of the lemon. Stir until the spinach wilts. Return the chicken and spoon the pan sauce over it.

label: FAQ: chicken too dry
text: Slice the breast in half horizontally so it cooks faster and stays juicy. Thighs also work and are harder to overcook.

label: FAQ: no lemon
text: A splash of white wine vinegar gives the sauce acidity. Bottled lemon juice works but tastes flatter.

label: Step 1
text: Heat the oven to 200 C (400 F). Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and the grated parmesan.

label: Step 2
text: Melt the butter in an oven-safe skillet and soften the sliced onion for five minutes. Add the spinach and stir until it wilts.

label: Step 3
text: Pour in the eggs and cook without stirring until the edges set. Move the skillet to the oven and bake until the center is set.

label: FAQ: no oven-safe skillet
text: Cook it covered on the stove over low heat until the top sets. The top will not brown.

label: Step 1
text: Scramble the eggs in a hot oiled skillet until just set and move them to a plate.

label: Step 2
text: Add the cold cooked rice and the peas. Spread the rice out and let it fry without stirring for a minute before tossing.

label: Step 3
text: Add the soy sauce and the eggs back in. Toss and finish with sliced scallions.

label: FAQ: freshly cooked rice
text: Fresh rice turns mushy. Spread it on a plate and chill it for 20 minutes first.

label: FAQ: no wok
text: A wide skillet works. Cook in two batches so the rice fries instead of steaming.

label: Tip
text: While the chicken sears, slice the garlic and squeeze the lemon for steps 3 and 4.

label: FAQ: sticking pan
text: Leave it a minute longer. Once the underside browns it releases on its own; forcing it tears the crust.

label: Tip
text: While the onion softens, whisk the eggs with the parmesan so step 3 is ready to pour.

label: Tip
text: Slice the scallions before you start: once the rice hits the pan everything moves fast.
